name: Kiwibit · Gremlet #48
description:
A round kiwi chick with no wings to speak of and a very long nose for finding worms.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Kiwibit in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
